admin_accounts_has_sign_in_name.name: admin_accounts_has_sign_in_name
admin_accounts_has_sign_in_name.value: "identity"."admin_accounts"."email" IS NOT NULL OR "identity"."admin_accounts"."phone_hash" IS NOT NULL

admin_accounts_active_is_set_up.name: admin_accounts_active_is_set_up
admin_accounts_active_is_set_up.value: "identity"."admin_accounts"."status" <> 'active' OR ("identity"."admin_accounts"."password_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "identity"."admin_accounts"."totp_secret_encrypted" IS NOT NULL)

admin_accounts_totp_reset_has_password.name: admin_accounts_totp_reset_has_password
admin_accounts_totp_reset_has_password.value: "identity"."admin_accounts"."status" <> 'totp_reset' OR ("identity"."admin_accounts"."password_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "identity"."admin_accounts"."totp_secret_encrypted" IS NULL)

journals_reason_required.name: journals_reason_required
journals_reason_required.value: ("ledger"."journals"."type" NOT IN ('custody.adjustment', 'earn.bonus', 'earn.adjustment', 'merchant.adjustment') AND "ledger"."journals"."reverses_journal_id" IS NULL) OR coalesce(btrim("ledger"."journals"."reason"), '') <> ''
